title: QA machines and starting state
summary: Simultaneous QA keeps its declared driver and admits every host using its registered OS. The inferred case platform must exist in that set; single-host cases require a matching host. Resume does not substitute a companion for the driver. Linux and Windows WSL blank screenshots restart a reused fixture desktop once, protecting connected RDP users and other logins; persistent blank frames report session and XFCE/xrdp log evidence.
